[[File:Trevor Partridge 2019 Match Play Championship.jpg|thumb|right|260px|At the [[2019 Match Play Championship]].]]
'''Trevor Partridge''' (GEMP handle '''Zarantai''')<ref name="gempc-83998">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=83998 Registered Players - 128], 8th GEMP Match Play Championship, forum.starwarsccg.org (2 January 2024). Preserved copy: [https://archive.org/details/2024_GEMPC_Registered_Players_128_forum_t83998 Internet Archive]. [[:File:SWCCG forum t83998 2024 GEMPC Registered Players.txt]]</ref> won the consolation bracket of the [[2019 Match Play Championship]].<ref name="yt-mpc2019">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=88-rZP-hBMA MPC 2019 Interview: Consolation Winner Trevor Partridge], Star Wars CCG (Players Committee YouTube, 1 May 2019). Overlay: Trevor Partridge Consolation Bracket Champion.</ref> He played the [[2024 Eclipse Major]].<ref name="pc-rem">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2024-04-eclipse-major-indianapolis-indiana-apr-5-7/ 2024 Eclipse Major], starwarsccg.org</ref>
